tasks.short: Organize archival records under a defensible classification scheme

steps.what: Develop classification systems preserving provenance and original order
Organize archival records by matching content to the classification scheme

loop.purpose: Suggest existing scheme terms for records without changing provenance relationships
loop.input: Arrangment brief, permitted content and versioned controlled terms
loop.output: Proposed record-to-term assignments with supporting passages and uncertainty
loop.check: Archivist checks semantic fit, provenance, hierarchy and whether original order is misrepresented
loop.stop: One revision maximum; uncertain assignments or unreadable records are arranged manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Native term lookup handles explicit codes but not varied unstructured descriptions

steps.what: Verify arrangement and adopt the classification assignments

tasks.design: Test controlled-term lookup and batch editing in the collection-management {OTHER} first. A bounded suggestion step handles ambiguous text while the archivist develops the scheme and approves the exact arrangement before adoption.
tasks.previous_blocker: Matching descriptions to terms is repetitive but preserving provenance requires judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Subject-suggestion tools can propose controlled vocabulary terms for review.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible topic classification can erase archival relationships.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the creating organisation and preserve evidential context.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of matching time returns to resolving difficult provenance questions.

evidence.claim: Annif supports assisted subject assignment; its capability does not establish correct archival arrangement.
The proposed matching reduction is an unmeasured archival scenario.

assumptions: Boundary includes arrangement and scheme development, excluding item description drafting allocated to its separate task.

Archivist produces record identifiers, parent relationships, provenance, original-order constraints, allowed term identifiers, scheme version and permitted content references in s1's 35 hours. Record inspection within s2 remains time-counted; missing text or hierarchy triggers manual arrangement.
OTHER means collection-management software. Native lookup and batch editing are tested before a model extension; existing runtime earns no saving.
Physical movement and preservation handling do not become faster under this design and remain inside the retained arrangement effort.
unknowns: Available digital descriptions and provenance completeness
research_questions: Can suggestions reduce matching effort without introducing provenance or hierarchy errors?

already_counted.description: Review suggestions, inspect ambiguous records and arrange exceptions manually

incremental.description: Maintain vocabulary tests and review suggestion drift

approvals.approved_version: Exact record-to-term and parent assignment snapshot bound to scheme version; any assignment or hierarchy change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+30+25=90, gross=10, upkeep=4, net=6. Range 0-3 allows substantial physical handling and provenance exceptions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect archival records and collect verified descriptive facts
Prepare document descriptions using source facts and description standards

loop.purpose: Draft concise archival descriptions with traceable source support
loop.input: Verified source packet and versioned description standard
loop.output: Description draft with field-level sources and explicit unknowns
loop.check: Archivist checks dates, creators, scope, uncertain readings, provenance and disclosure restrictions against originals
loop.stop: One correction pass; unsupported facts or unreadable sources return to manual description
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates fill fixed facts but cannot write a faithful scope-and-content note from varied materials

steps.what: Check descriptions and release approved catalogue entries

tasks.design: Reuse native field defaults and description templates in collection-management {OTHER} first. A bounded draft step works from verified material in {DOCS}; the archivist checks the final record and access restrictions before releasing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative descriptions require repeated synthesis of source material.
tasks.enabler_now: Metadata assistants can propose catalogue records for human acceptance or correction.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting incomplete records without turning guesses into catalogue facts.
tasks.human_edge: Represent uncertainty and historical context accurately.
tasks.altitude: Some composition time returns to investigating uncertain provenance.

reach.learn: Archival description standards and uncertainty notation

evidence.claim: Alma AI Metadata Assistant drafts catalogue records for acceptance, correction or discard; archival narrative quality still needs testing.
Drafting savings are a modelled scenario rather than a measured archive result.

assumptions: Boundary covers descriptive records, excluding scheme development and physical preservation.

Archivist captures item identifier, collection and parent identifier, creator attribution, date with uncertainty, extent, source references and access restrictions in s1's 30 hours. Source packet includes readable text or original images; missing facts remain unknown and missing transcription is completed manually within retained s2 time.
OTHER means collection-management software. Test native defaults and templates first; existing scanning or indexing runtime earns no labour saving.
No mass public release occurs without checking the exact description and its restrictions.
research_questions: Does verified draft preparation reduce total effort while preserving uncertainty and access restrictions?

already_counted.description: Read originals, correct generated descriptions and complete unsupported cases manually

incremental.description: Maintain description examples, privacy tests and field mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact final description fields, source references and access setting snapshot; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+27+25=82, gross=18, upkeep=5, net=13. Range 0-8 allows illegible sources and extensive contextual correction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain retrievable electronic archives and databases

steps.what: Specify archive database mappings and retrieval requirements
Load computer archives and databases using approved import mappings
Test retrieval, accessibility and preservation before promoting the archive version

tasks.design: Configure native import mappings and validation in the archival repository {OTHER}. Imports enter an isolated staging version; the archivist checks retrieval, accessibility, fixity and permissions before promoting that exact version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated loading and mapping across heterogeneous sources takes manual effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned import profiles and native repository validation can repeat known mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Format obsolescence and confirming that records remain meaningful and usable.
tasks.human_edge: Define what successful access and preservation mean for the collection.
tasks.altitude: Less routine loading, with retained responsibility for preservation and retrieval tests.

reach.learn: Fixity, persistent identifiers and access testing

evidence.claim: Native repository import profiles can repeat validated mappings; the saving assumes manual loading exists today.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining electronic archives through import and validation, excluding description creation and collection appraisal. Existing automatic backups and indexing receive no claimed saving.

Source system administrator supplies export files with identifiers, parent relationships, file references, formats, checksums and current permissions before s1. Archivist captures mapping version, approved access translation, validation checks and retrieval samples in s1's 30 hours. Missing fields block automated staging and go to manual correction within s3; nothing is silently discarded.
OTHER means archival repository software. Native staged imports are tested before custom integration. No live overwrite or deletion is automated.
Only additional export maintenance is counted as other-role incremental work; focal exception handling remains in s3.
unknowns: Whether manual loading is still required
research_questions: Can native imports remove repeated loading without increasing failed retrieval or permission leakage?

already_counted.description: Retrieval, accessibility, fixity and permission testing plus import exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain mappings, test format changes and rehearse rollback
Maintain source export metadata and interfaces

approvals.approved_version: Exact staged archive snapshot, import profile, checksums, permission map and test results; any changed record or permission voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+0+35=65, gross=35, focal upkeep=10, net=25. Range 0-15 covers limited import volumes and substantial migration exceptions; source administrator time stays outside focal savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish and administer public access policy

steps.what: Establish access policy guidelines and resolve material-use exceptions

tasks.design: Keep policy establishment and substantive access exceptions with the archivist using {DOCS}. Routine permission enforcement belongs to repository configuration; it does not replace the policy judgements counted here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Access depends on interacting donor, privacy, preservation and public-interest considerations.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated technical change removes those policy judgements.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing access against confidentiality and physical fragility.
tasks.human_edge: Explain a fair, proportionate restriction and recognise when it should be reconsidered.
tasks.altitude: The archivist retains public access policy responsibility.

reach.learn: Donor agreements, privacy and preservation constraints

evidence.claim: Public access policy and substantive exceptions require contextual judgement; no local labour saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is policy design and substantive administration, not routine authentication, catalogue publication or database permission testing allocated elsewhere.
No new structured input, automatic disclosure decision or delegated policy authority is proposed.
Existing native repository permissions continue without a new saving claim.
Zero incremental upkeep because no additional tool or workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Collection ownership and binding donor obligations
research_questions: Is routine request administration a distinct, measurable task that could use existing configuration?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Substantive policy and exception decisions remain fully human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The archivist retains provenance, preservation and access decisions while checking selected draft and import operations.
role.ambitious_version: An archivist with dependable descriptions and retrievable records whose time remains available for collection context and fair access.
